summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in LLMs, AI infrastructure, and applications. OpenAI's CFO shares lessons on building an AI-native finance function, while Meta's new Glimmer model offers a glimpse into Mark Zuckerberg's superintelligence vision. Other notable developments include Anthropic's plans to design its own hardware and Cloudflare's launch of a browser for AI agents.
insight: The increasing focus on responsible AI development and deployment is a common thread throughout this week's news, with companies like OpenAI and Anthropic prioritizing security and safety in their models and products.

Meta's new Glimmer model offers a glimpse into Mark Zuckerberg's superintelligence vision
